verdict.rationale: Asking for official SDKs is a fair question for a self-hostable remote-desktop platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no official SDK. The closest items are a Server Pro "management API" (an API, not an SDK), a demo repo for writing your own rendezvous/relay server, and internal libraries such as libs/clipboard; these are adjacent building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
